about_the_game:
A melancholic tale in an endless desert

The solitary existence of a little universe is a dark fantasy visual novel about immortality, loneliness, and the search for a final end.

You awaken in absolute darkness with no memory of who you are. As consciousness returns, you find yourself in a vast, lonely desert beneath an indigo starry sky. You are immortal—cursed to exist forever by a cruel commandment that compels you to preserve your consciousness at all costs, even as you long for oblivion.

But you are not alone.

A mysterious child appears before you, curious and innocent, seeing wonder in a world you can only experience as desolate. Together, you embark on a journey across the forsaken desert toward a distant castle—a place where you hope to finally find the release from existence you so desperately seek.

Features

  • Melancholic Atmosphere: Explore a hauntingly beautiful desert world filled with ancient ruins, abandoned caravans, and forgotten civilizations

  • Philosophical Narrative: Confront themes of mortality, consciousness, memory, and the meaning of existence

  • Meaningful Choices: Your decisions shape your journey and each choice will give you a different view of this mysterious world

  • Multiple Paths: Discover different endings based on your choices throughout the story

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains images that may not be suitable for a non-adult audience, such as images of skeletons or monsters.

This game contains themes of existential dread, death, and despair. Player discretion is advised.

short_description: In this dark interactive novel you will play as a lost soul wandering a forsaken desert, accompanied by a mysterious girl. Explore ancient ruins and face obscure choices. Your decisions will shape their journey—often in ways you’ll never fully understand. Will you find peace, or something else?
